scope: Offline one-error Japanese spelling and near-sound suggestions; preserve normal conversion, literal preedit and confirmation.

implementation.queryState: One converter, independent normal/n-alternative/correction sessions. Each alternative/correction query clears its session state before querying.
implementation.ranking: Error cost, original fallback spans, lexical and left/right connection gain; final full-ruby/full-consumption real-dictionary evidence plus normalized lattice score margin.
implementation.models: Classic typo, Zenzai and experimental LM APIs stay disabled. No network, persistent learning or whole-word example mapping.

semantics.target: shitsuka retains literal preedit しつか, suggests real 静か/しずか with reading annotation しずか.
semantics.consumption: Full correction consumes original query input elements, including separators, not modified-query composingCount.
semantics.return: Without selection, Return confirms literal kana.
semantics.metadata: Candidate strip, expanded panel and VoiceOver refresh source/reading even for unchanged body; dedup uses text plus consumption.
semantics.selection: Space selection freezes full list; stale revision or ended composition rejects late results.

additionalRootCause: A long sentence with two n separator alternatives stalled upstream incremental lattice replacement. Clearing only the alternative session before each unrelated query resolved this; shared dictionary caching remains.

validation.sampling: Only related input/prediction/host/correction/performance tests. No repeated keyboard coverage grid or per-emoji scan.
validation.uiRegression: User confirmed emoji bottom clear, space cursor can move up then down, and ordinary backspace has no popup.
validation.initialDeviceAttempt: Installation connection closed before tests started; reconnected and completed same tests successfully.

measurements.method: Debug, real attached UIWindow/UITextView, actual bundled dictionary. Before/after normal benchmark: one warm pass then three equal passes, 84 publications each. Idle correction: one warm plus ten measured passes, 30 publications across shitsuka/nihongoo/kikoro, 220 Roman keys. Rapid input: 35 burst plus 35 paced at 20 ms. New correction words and normal warm words are different workloads; do not compare their p95 as a regression. Observed warm variation is not proof of a causal speedup. Memory is test host phys_footprint, not a measured extension memory ceiling.

knownLimitations: Independent legitimate-word corpus has 1/15 unnecessary suggestion: amefurashi suggests amegurashi. This is an optional suggestion, not automatic rewriting. Small synthetic corpora do not estimate human error rates.

takaai is protected as a legitimate surname reading and misses intended takai; yasahii suggests yashii instead of expected yasashii. Simulator also misses soshitee within the time budget; device resolves it.
Single-error search only, bounded length, skip unfinished trailing consonants. No partial correction consumption or submitted-host-paragraph language context.

60 ms is a soft budget checked before querying; one upstream synchronous query cannot be interrupted and can exceed it. Already running work may postpone a newer candidate calculation; main-thread preedit stays immediate.
Estimated soft-wrap cursor navigation still depends on truncated proxy context and approximate host font/width.
